fields.summary_ko.0: Anthropic (ANT) opened at $111.50 from an IPO price of $83, recording a 34% premium, and historically may experience weakness following elevated initial demand.
fields.summary_ko.1: SpaceX (SPCX) opened at $150 from $135 in June, rising to $211 but declining nearly 50% from the August low, while Meta (META) experienced a 40% decline within six months after its 2012 IPO.
fields.summary_ko.2: Despite elevated initial IPO demand, Meta has gained over 1900% long-term post-IPO, and even attractive growth stories may be unrelated to near-term price performance.
